name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_cyclic_deriv_roots
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_deriv_roots (hp : 0 < p) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (root : Fin p → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono root)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hroot : ∀ i, f (root i) = 0)
    (hshift : ∀ t, f t = 0 → f (t + T) = 0)
    (hdshift : ∀ t, deriv f (t + T) = 0 → deriv f t = 0) :
    ∃ point : Fin p → ℝ, Function.Injective point ∧
      (∀ i, point i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) ∧ (∀ i, deriv f (point i) = 0)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_cyclic_rolle_points
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_rolle_points (hp : 0 < p) (T : ℝ) (_hT : 0 < T)
    (root : Fin p → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono root)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hroot : ∀ i, f (root i) = 0)
    (hshift : ∀ t, f t = 0 → f (t + T) = 0)
    (hdshift : ∀ t, deriv f (t + T) = 0 → deriv f t = 0) :
    ∃ point : Fin p → ℝ,
      (∀ i, point i ∈ Set.Ioo (root i) (cyclicRolleNext hp root T i)) ∧
      (∀ i, deriv f (point i) = 0) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i => cyclicRolleReduce T (point i)) ∧
      (∀ i, cyclicRolleReduce T (point i) ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) ∧
      (∀ i, deriv f (cyclicRolleReduce T (point i)) = 0)

statement:
theorem cayleyOperator_coeff_succ (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (cayleyOperator p P).coeff (n + 1) =
      P.coeff (n + 2) * ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + P.coeff n * ((n : ℝ) - (p : ℝ))

statement:

theorem cayleyOperator_eval (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (x : ℝ) :
    (cayleyOperator p P).eval x =
      (1 + x ^ 2) * P.derivative.eval x - (p : ℝ) * x * P.eval x

    ∃ Q : ℝ[X], Q.natDegree ≤ p - 1 ∧

    (hDloc : ∀ q, crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j
      (crossDifferenceRootIndex i q) (Droot q))

      (crossSumRootIndex j q) (Troot q))

        ∃ q, Troot q = t)

          homogeneousTrig (n - 2) Q t) ∧

statement:
